public_README_exact_paragraph: Three additional cases have source-authenticated conflicting study descriptions: `RAN1_P5_CQ5-1` names TR 38.859 as Ambient IoT although its archived title/Scope identifies NR positioning; `RAN1_P5_CQ5-2` labels TR 38.802 as RedCap although it identifies New Radio physical layer aspects; `RAN4_P5_CQ4-3` labels TR 38.860 as RedCap RF although it identifies the Extended 600 MHz NR band study. Their `conflicting_entity_description` classification is conditional on requiring consistent named descriptions or an explicit truthful false-premise response policy. If numeric identifiers and original queries are normative, an answer can explicitly correct the description and retain the fixed identifier. No different TR is substituted. The portable evidence in `sources/conflicting_TR_description_evidence/` contains exact original English/query hashes, 13 source paragraph XML witnesses, archive/member/full-XML pins, and separate seven-unit checks by two AI reviewers. Its default check verifies the bundled evidence and rejects wrong question hashes, source identities and missing title witnesses; optional `--source-root` additionally reopens the pinned originals. Different official study titles do not prove absence of every body mention of another technology. Bibliography completeness, incoming reference coverage and actual study-to-spec outcome evidence remain separately pending, and none of these three becomes an admitted answer. The broader Agenda 7.1/MIMO case remains evidence-pending because a maintenance heading alone does not exclude a MIMO-topic intersection.

three_cases.original_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.859'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber
three_cases.condition: The benchmark requires consistent named descriptions or an explicit truthful false-premise response policy. Numeric-ID-first with an explicit correction is a viable recovery; separate answer-evidence gates remain pending.
three_cases.recovery_condition: If the preserved numeric identifier/query is normative, explicitly correct the description and answer that identifier; this is viable and defeats permanent-unanswerability claims. Do not silently substitute a different topic-matching identifier.

shared_structure: All four questions retain an explicit numeric identifier, a topic/name assertion, and an original query using that number. Numeric query is affirmative recovery counterauthority; it does not by itself establish that the description may be discarded.
real_difference_not_exaggerated: A maintenance agenda can contain MIMO-relevant CSI/SRS material. Official heading mismatch therefore does not prove that every technical MIMO conjunction is empty. The public TR policy itself also refuses to infer absence of all body mentions from differing titles.
not_found_in_read_authority: Own CQ1 membership/header rules are generic. Neither the immutable English nor those source/design passages document that its repeated MIMO descriptions were a later translation error or were declared nonrestrictive. Current Korean snapshot was modified and cannot establish original intent.
conclusion: No source-grounded exception licenses unqualified numeric-first admission here while preserving the existing conditional TR policy. Recommend conditional clarification, with the fully verified numeric11 route explicitly retained.
